name: Vanguard of Valkyrie

skills.description: Deals 100% Spell Power as Frost DMG to 1 enemy within melee range.

scaling.text: Frost DMG equal to 100% of Spell Power

skills.name: Valkyrie Flurry
skills.description: Edelle flies through the air at high speed, deals attack 12 times to surrounding enemies within 6 meters in 2 sec, each attack causes Frost Damage equal to 75% of Spell Power, and knock away the weak enemies continuously. Edelle is Invincible during the duration.

scaling.text: Frost DMG equal to 75% of Spell Power

skills.name: Lead the Charge
skills.description: Edelle charges through the enemies 2 times, causes Frost Damage equal to 125% of Spell Power to the enemies hit.

scaling.text: Frost DMG equal to 125% of Spell Power

skills.name: Might of Valkyries
skills.description: Vanguard of Valkyrie's Skill Crit% +10%; for each 1 additional allied unit on the field, Skill Crit% +3%; the added Skill Crit Chance cannot exceed 30%.

skills.name: Sanctuary of Justice
skills.description: When Edelle is on the field, all allied Blackguards regenerate Shield Value equal to 200% of Edelle's Spell Power every 3 sec.

scaling.text: Shield equal to 200% of Spell Power

skills.name: Trinity Force
skills.description: Each time an allied unit applies a kind of elemental abnormal status (Chill, Ignition, Electrocution), Vanguard of Valkyrie gains 1 stack of [Trinity Force] (applying the same status repeatedly adds only 1 stack), up to 3 stacks, lasting 5 seconds. Each stack of [Trinity Force] increases Vanguard of Valkyrie's DMG by 16%.

skills.name: Honor of Knight
skills.description: Duration of [Trinity Force] is increased by 100%, DMG Dealt of [Valkyrie Flurry] and [Lead the Charge] is additionally increased by 400%. All allied Summons' Damage Dealt is increased by 5%, Edelle's per point of Spell Mastery additionally increases allied Summons' Damage Dealt by 0.1%, up to 15%.

skills.name: One Man Army
skills.description: More targets means its harder to miss, each enemy within a range of 5 meters will increase damage caused by 3%
Mercilessly executes wounded enemies: DMG dealt to targets with HP below 15% is increased by 20%

skills.name: Berserker's Wrath
skills.description: The sight of your own blood enrages you, the lower your health, the higher your damage Increases damage by 1% for every 5% HP lost

skills.name: Barricade
skills.description: Activate barricade to reduce all damage taken by 30% when HP reaches the 75%/45%/15% thresholds, lasts 2.5 seconds
